In addition, brief bursts of synchronous motor unit discharges were elicited in antagonist muscle pairs by unexpected sound, tap or voluntary action. EMG exam of muscles in the upper limbs, upper trunk and distal parts of the lower limbs showed normal silent period at rest. Fibrillations, fasciculations, or myotonic discharges were not found in any muscles. Study of cutaneo-muscular reflexes in the legs using the technique described by Meinck et al. (5), disclosed enhanced widespread responses (especially from quadriceps bilaterally) with abnormally low stimulus threshold.
